title: SaMaCraft Server
description: A small mostly german Minecraft Server built with love.
body:
# SaMaCraft

SaMaCraft is a small Minecraft Server out of Germany. We have a small Comunity and Manage the Server in our time between work. We want a non toxic Enviroment and love to get new Poeple into the Server. We mainly speak german but are also welcome to new People from all over the world. for joining the server you have to make a simple whitelist request in our discord because we dont want any bots on our Server. 
Feel free to come to SaMaCraft <3
